title: Portfolio Section
description: Reusable, prop-driven portfolio surface covering both list (/portfolio) and detail (/portfolio/[slug]) views. List supports three layouts: uniform 16:9 grid (1-3 columns), CSS-columns masonry (variable aspect), and asymmetric (first item spans 2 cols, then rows of 3). Detail renders cover hero, ProjectMeta row (year/client/role/tags), body via consumer-supplied renderBody (defaults to paragraph split), optional gallery grid, external link, and 'More work' related grid. Pure server component, no client JS, no Convex tables — every template controls routing via hrefFor.
